test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) every week

(B) we

(C) play

(D) cricket
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **BACD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "we," which is correctly indicated by **part (B).**
 
• Following the subject, the verb "every week" **(BA)** continues the logical sequence by adding the time frame.
 
• **The next part,** "play" (BAC), making it clear what action is being performed.
 
• **Ending with **"cricket" (BACD) completes the sentence by adding the object to the sentence, clarifying what is being played.

Therefore, the correct answer is **BACD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (BADC):** This option starts with "we play every week cricket," which does not follow correct grammatical structure.
 
• **Option 3 (DACB):** This option starts with "cricket every week we play," which disrupts the natural flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (CADB):** This option starts with "play cricket we every week," which creates a confusing and fragmented sentence structure.

Note: This is a PYP question, and the official answer key has marked (correct option) as the correct answer, hence we cannot make any changes to it.
